summary: Changes from v1: (1) WP1 now includes a PURELY ADDITIVE channels.py edit — add a `caustic_theta: float` field to the ChangRefsdalGeometryPartition dataclass, populated from `caustic.theta` in channels.geometry_partition (which already computes `caustic = geometry.nearest_caustic_point(...)` but currently keeps only `caustic.distance`); no logic/ordering changes and reconstruct_from_envelope's consumed fields are untouched. (2) WP1 selection step (4) corrected: read eta = partition.caustic_distance, theta = partition.caustic_theta, image_count = partition.real_mask.sum() — recompute nothing (the partition does NOT carry theta today; image count is real_mask.sum(), no new field). (3) WP1 'how' now records that any other constructor of ChangRefsdalGeometryPartition must be updated for the new field (verify via find_referencing_symbols + grep; default the field only if a genuine non-channels constructor exists). (4) channels.py added to files_affected and its 'untouched' claim in WP1 replaced with 'the single additive caustic_theta field only'. All other WPs, Professor inputs, Simplifier inputs, and test descriptions are UNCHANGED. --- ENV-NOTE (non-blocking): This session had an environment-wide tool failure — Serena, Read, Glob and the Explore/Plan subagents' file tools all returned 'No such tool available', so I could not open source files or write the architect_short_term memory checkpoint; the plan is design-level and driver-verified on the code-pin points below. --- Build 8c turns the single-box 8a envelope surrogate into a GLOBAL, multi-chart, first-class data product covering the full prior box and BOTH parities, WITHOUT enabling it by default (default None stays byte-identical) and WITH only the single additive channels.py field as the sole engine-adjacent change. Core design (owner-binding, Professor-ratified): (1) near-caustic TUBE charts in adapted coords (gamma, u=sqrt(eta), theta, log w) with eta/theta from geometry.nearest_caustic_point — the caustic is the fixed plane eta=0 and u=sqrt(eta) absorbs the fold branch of E itself (Professor: E, not just its derivative, carries the sqrt(eta) branch; fit Re and Im separately; theta is a bounded, non-periodic per-fold-arc coordinate); (2) plain raw-coord FAR-FIELD charts, one per image-count region, for the smooth interior / one-image side / w->0 macro plateau; (3) cusp neighborhoods EXCLUDED (2/3-power singularity breaks the sqrt model) and served by the exact engine, with (theta_cusp, Delta_theta) + eta_floor recorded per chart; (4) deterministic query-time chart selection keyed on the certified caustic_distance eta + image-count (never on gauge theta, per F017), tube>far-field by an eta priority threshold, gamma guard-band around gamma=1, all fall-throughs going to the exact engine (no new refusals). The artifact is a single npz (Simplifier trim: named per-chart tensors + a JSON provenance scalar; NO bespoke manifest format), registered in DATA_CONTRACTS.yaml + data_registry.yaml with LensAmplificationSurrogate.load enrolled in regenerate_consumer_graph.py LOADERS. Two load paths only (package-data default under cogwheel/data/ + explicit override; data_registry cluster-path LOAD fallback deferred with a TODO, per Simplifier). An offline training driver (importable module + thin CLI) builds charts from the prior-box read from the prior classes, derives cusp structure from the geometry engine (caustic-speed minima, no hard-coded cusp counts), with per-chart engine-call budgets and per-chart-file resumability; a census tool measures served fraction, held-out envelope eps, and lnL accuracy tiers. The parity subtlety is resolved: the tube machinery is parity-agnostic (a fold is a fold on the astroid AND the saddle deltoid); only the geometry input differs. In-build acceptance is a SMALL multi-chart fixture (one fold-crossing tube segment + one far-field chart per parity, coarse grids); full-box production training is deferred post-build (owner ruling A). Backward compat: an 8a single-box artifact loads as a one-chart special case and existing 8a tests keep passing. No sampling/PP runs; no enable-by-default flip.

work_packages.title: Multi-chart surrogate structure, adapted tube/far-field charts, and deterministic chart selection
work_packages.what: Extend cogwheel/lensing/surrogate.py from the single-box 8a LensAmplificationSurrogate into a GLOBAL multi-chart emulator: a flat collection of charts (near-caustic TUBE charts in (gamma, u=sqrt(eta), theta, log w) and raw-coord FAR-FIELD charts in (gamma, y1_eig, y2_eig, log w)), a deterministic overlap-free query-time chart-selection guard stack, cusp/exclusion recording, single-npz multi-chart serialization with provenance, two load paths, and backward-compatible single-box (one-chart) behavior. Wire the single likelihood serving intercept to feed the geometry partition (caustic_distance eta, caustic_theta, image-count via real_mask.sum()) to the surrogate query. Make ONE purely additive change to channels.py: add a caustic_theta field to ChangRefsdalGeometryPartition populated from caustic.theta. NO engine-logic changes.
where: cogwheel/lensing/surrogate.py (primary); cogwheel/lensing/channels.py (SINGLE additive edit: add `caustic_theta: float` to the ChangRefsdalGeometryPartition dataclass ~line 1043 area and populate it from `caustic.theta` in geometry_partition, which already binds `caustic = geometry.nearest_caustic_point(...)`); cogwheel/lensing/likelihood.py (minimal: the existing amplification_surrogate serving intercept in LensedRelativeBinningLikelihood must pass the geometry_partition to the surrogate query).
work_packages.how: FIRST re-derive exact signatures with find_symbol: LensAmplificationSurrogate (__init__, the envelope query method, the domain gate, save/load, the eigenframe beta-elimination), the likelihood serving intercept (channels.geometry_partition + surrogate envelope + reconstruct_from_envelope, incl. the INS-8a-001 kappa!=0 fall-through), channels.geometry_partition + the ChangRefsdalGeometryPartition dataclass (driver-verified fields: w, delays, saddle_kernels, switch, critical_delay, real_mask, caustic_distance — NO theta today), and geometry.nearest_caustic_point / geometry.NearestCausticPoint (geometry.py line 121 NamedTuple carrying distance AND theta = polar angle in [0,2*pi) at the closest critical-curve point). CHANNELS.PY EDIT (the ONLY authorized change there, permitted by the brief's 'channels.py only if a chart-selection helper genuinely needs a seam' carve-out): add a `caustic_theta: float` field to ChangRefsdalGeometryPartition and populate it from `caustic.theta` inside geometry_partition (the value is already computed — it is currently discarded, only caustic.distance is stored). NO logic changes, NO reordering; reconstruct_from_envelope's consumed fields (delays, saddle_kernels, switch, critical_delay) stay byte-identical. Verify with find_referencing_symbols + grep whether ChangRefsdalGeometryPartition has any OTHER constructor besides geometry_partition; update every constructor for the new field, and default it only if a genuine non-channels constructor exists (do not add a default merely to avoid touching geometry_partition). DESIGN (Simplifier 'trim' rulings): represent a chart as a FROZEN dataclass, NOT a class hierarchy — two dataclasses (TubeChart, FarFieldChart) stored in a list; selection is a plain function, no polymorphism. TubeChart carries: coord axes (gamma, u=sqrt(eta), theta, log w), separate Re/Im prefiltered not-a-knot B-spline coefficient tensors + knot vectors (reuse the 8a spline machinery), image-count label + parity, and exclusion data {eta_floor, eta_max, list of (theta_cusp, Delta_theta) cusp windows}. theta is a BOUNDED, NON-PERIODIC coordinate spanning a single inter-cusp fold arc (Professor Q1: do NOT wrap theta periodically; cusp-exclude both ends). Fit Re(E) and Im(E) SEPARATELY, BOTH in u=sqrt(eta) (Professor Q1: the envelope itself — not just its derivative — carries the sqrt(eta) branch; u=sqrt(eta) is the minimal correct reparametrization; the tube covers ONLY the image-pair-present side eta>0). FarFieldChart is a plain raw-coord (gamma, y1_eig, y2_eig, log w) tensor spline (reuse 8a exactly), one PER image-count region, carrying an image-count guard and eta_overlap_min. CHART SELECTION guard stack at query time (Professor Q7, execute in this order, all fall-throughs return None so the likelihood uses the exact engine): (1) certified-box containment on (gamma, log w); (2) gamma guard band |gamma-1| < delta_gamma (~1e-3) -> fall through (prevents the parity/image-count mis-classification analog of INS-8a-001); (3) inherited engine-refusal exclusion-ball check -> fall through; (4) read eta = partition.caustic_distance, theta = partition.caustic_theta, image_count = partition.real_mask.sum() from the passed geometry partition — recompute NOTHING; (5) image-count guard: the candidate chart's image-count label must match — else skip that chart; (6) cusp exclusion: if |theta - theta_cusp| < Delta_theta for any cusp of the chart, or eta < eta_floor -> fall through; (7) priority rule: serve TUBE when eta in [eta_floor, eta_max] and not cusp-excluded; else serve FAR-FIELD when eta > eta_overlap_min and in its box; else fall through. Selection MUST key only on the certified physical eta + image-count, NEVER on gauge theta except for the cusp-window test (F017). SERIALIZATION (Simplifier 'trim'): a SINGLE npz — named arrays chart{i}_re_coeffs / chart{i}_im_coeffs / chart{i}_knots_* / chart{i}_meta plus one JSON-encoded provenance scalar (training grid spec, engine version/commit, training hash, prior-box definition, per-chart exclusion data, chart count/types). NO bespoke manifest file. save()/load() round-trip must be exact. LOAD PATHS: package-data default resolving under cogwheel/data/ (importlib.resources), plus an explicit path override argument; add a TODO comment at the load site marking where the data_registry cluster-path fallback goes (DEFERRED per Simplifier — do NOT implement it now). BACKWARD COMPAT: an 8a single-box npz must load as a one-chart FarFieldChart special case so the 8a tests and API keep working; the 8a single-box constructor/save path stays supported. DEFAULT amplification_surrogate=None must keep every likelihood path byte-identical (crown max|diff|=0), and with the surrogate absent the new caustic_theta field is simply carried unused. Do NOT author tests (Test Developer owns all new tests).

work_packages.title: Offline training driver: build the multi-chart artifact from the prior box
work_packages.what: Add an importable training core plus a thin CLI that builds the full multi-chart surrogate artifact from the prior-box definition read from the prior classes: per parity, per gamma, derive caustic geometry + cusp locations from the geometry engine, build tube charts per fold arc and far-field charts per image-count region under per-chart engine-call budgets, with per-chart-file resumability and a machine-usable JSON training report. In-build runs only at smoke scale; the full-box production run is a deferred post-build driver step.
where: cogwheel/lensing/surrogate_training.py (new, importable core); scripts/train_lens_surrogate.py (new, thin argparse CLI wrapper).
work_packages.how: Read the prior box from the prior classes (LensedIASPrior / FixedLensGeometryPrior and the lens subpriors — gamma in (0,1.6), the mass-conditioned (u1,u2) box, the w band from the mass range; find exact symbols first) — do NOT hard-code ranges. Derive caustic structure from the GEOMETRY ENGINE, not hard-coded cusp counts (Professor Q9): for each gamma, sample the caustic parametrization at ~100-200 theta points via geometry.nearest_caustic_point / the caustic curve, finite-difference the caustic SPEED |dcaustic/dtheta|, and locate cusps as local speed minima below ~1e-6; set Delta_theta from the width of each speed dip times a safety factor; store (theta_cusp, Delta_theta) per gamma. Cross-check the detected cusp count against the expected topology (4 on the positive-parity astroid gamma<1; 6 = 2 lobes x 3 on the saddle deltoid gamma>1) and record it (a mismatch is a flagged error, not a silent pass). The chart-building code is PARITY-AGNOSTIC (Professor Q8): the same routine builds an astroid fold tube and a deltoid fold tube — only the geometry input differs. Build, per parity: tube charts (one per inter-cusp fold arc, covering eta in [eta_floor, eta_max], theta between cusp walls, on the image-pair-present side), and far-field charts (one per image-count region; skip a lobe-interior far-field chart when the lobe diameter < 2*eta_max, since the tube then covers it — Professor Q10). Engine envelope samples come from F_op_grid / reconstruct_from_envelope via the same path the 8a trainer used (reuse 8a training helpers; find them first — driver-confirmed reusable). Per-chart engine-call budget is a CLI parameter. RESUMABILITY (Simplifier 'watch' trim): write each chart to its own per-chart npz and skip it at loop start if the file already exists — a simple existence check, NO structured within-chart progress manifest. At the end, pack the per-chart files into the single artifact npz via the WP1 save() API. Emit a machine-usable JSON training report: per-chart node counts, engine-call counts, held-out envelope eps, detected cusps, timing, and the measured final artifact size in bytes (needed for the package-data-vs-cluster destination call). Keep all logic in surrogate_training.py; scripts/train_lens_surrogate.py is a ~10-line argparse wrapper. In-build: run only at smoke scale (a reduced grid); the expensive full-box run is DEFERRED. Do NOT author tests.
work_packages.verification: surrogate_training.py builds charts from the prior-box read from the prior classes (no hard-coded ranges), derives cusp locations from the geometry engine's caustic-speed minima (no hard-coded cusp counts) and cross-checks the topology, is parity-agnostic across astroid and deltoid folds, is resumable by per-chart-file existence, packs into the WP1 single-npz artifact via save(), and emits a JSON training report including measured artifact size; scripts/train_lens_surrogate.py is a thin CLI over it.

work_packages.title: Census tool: served fraction, held-out eps, and lnL accuracy tiers
work_packages.what: Add an importable census core plus a thin CLI that, given a trained artifact, measures over prior-box samples: served fraction (target >=95% away from exclusions), held-out envelope eps per chart, and lnL accuracy tiers vs the exact engine (crown <=0.01 nats; strong-shear/saddle <=0.1; rescued at RB tolerance), emitting a machine-usable census report. This is the enable-by-default EVIDENCE machinery, not the enablement.
where: cogwheel/lensing/surrogate_census.py (new, importable core); scripts/census_lens_surrogate.py (new, thin CLI).
work_packages.how: Draw prior-box samples in the SAMPLED coordinates directly from the prior (Professor Q5: measure served fraction against the prior measure in sampled coords; no importance weights when drawing from the prior). Served = the surrogate returns a value (not a fall-through); report served fraction and the fall-through breakdown (cusp-excluded / gamma-guard-band / out-of-box / refusal-ball). Held-out envelope eps per chart = max|E_interp - E_engine| / max(|E_engine|, 1e-6) on held-out points (Professor: relative envelope error normalized by |E_engine|, consistent with the F016 reconstruction gate). lnL tiers: partition configs by gamma (primary), image-count/parity (secondary), caustic distance eta (tertiary) — NEVER by gauge theta (Professor Q4); compute |lnL_surrogate - lnL_exact| per config and check crown (gamma<~0.5) <=0.01 nats, strong-shear/saddle (gamma>~0.5) <=0.1 nats (Professor: ~1/15 of RB_ATOL=1.5, driver-confirmed real; the surrogate error is gated a factor >=10 BELOW the RB-binning floor, F016 — NOT compared to brute force), rescued (near box boundaries / Schwinger ceiling) up to RB_ATOL. Emit a JSON census report with the tier tables, served fraction, per-chart eps, and the measured artifact size. Keep logic in surrogate_census.py; scripts/census_lens_surrogate.py is a thin argparse wrapper. In-build: run only on the small fixture artifact. Do NOT author tests, and do NOT run a full-box census (deferred).
work_packages.verification: surrogate_census.py loads a trained artifact, draws prior samples in sampled coordinates, and reports served fraction (with fall-through breakdown), per-chart held-out envelope eps, and gamma/image-count/eta-partitioned lnL tiers checked against crown<=0.01 / strong-saddle<=0.1 / rescued<=RB with the surrogate error gated below the RB floor; it emits a JSON census report including measured artifact size; scripts/census_lens_surrogate.py is a thin CLI over it.

domain_test_descriptions: CHART SELECTION DETERMINISM + NO-OVERLAP. Setup: a small multi-chart fixture surrogate (one fold-crossing tube segment + one far-field chart, per parity, coarse grids). Operation: query a batch of points spanning the tube band, the far-field region, the overlap band, the cusp windows, the gamma-guard band, and outside the box; repeat each query. Expected: each point maps to exactly one served chart or a fall-through, resolved by the deterministic eta-priority rule (tube wins for eta<eta_priority, both accurate there); repeated queries return bit-identical chart choices and values; no point is ever served by two charts. Diagnostic: a scatter of (eta, gamma) colored by chosen chart, showing a clean priority boundary and exclusion holes.

TUBE BEATS EQUAL-BUDGET RAW CHART THROUGH THE NEAR-CAUSTIC BAND (the design's falsifiable claim; Professor Q2). Setup: fix a representative gamma (~0.35 positive parity; and a saddle-parity gamma for the deltoid twin), single fold arc; define the near-caustic band eta in [eta_excl, eta_max~0.05], theta across the fold arc, log w over the band. Build a tube-chart spline (in u=sqrt(eta)) and a raw-coord (y1_eig,y2_eig,log w) spline from the SAME engine-call budget over the same band. Operation: evaluate both at held-out points drawn uniformly in eta (weights small eta heavily) and compute relative envelope error eps=|E_interp-E_engine|/max(|E_engine|,1e-6). Expected: tube 95th-percentile eps < raw 95th-percentile eps by a factor >=3, and tube max eps < raw max eps. Diagnostic: overlaid eps histograms (tube vs raw) on the band.

FOLD-APPROACH RAY — sqrt(eta) fitting stays bounded as eta->0 (Professor Q3). Setup: fix gamma, theta at a fold-arc midpoint, log w mid-band; a geometric ray eta_k = eta_max * 0.5^k from ~0.1 down to the exclusion floor (~10 points, 3 decades). Operation: evaluate the tube interpolant and (for contrast) a raw-coord interpolant against the engine at each eta_k. Expected: tube relative envelope error stays bounded (<1e-3, consistent with the F016 reconstruction gate) and roughly flat as eta->0, while the raw-coord error grows toward small eta (~slope -1/2 on log-log). Diagnostic: log-log eps-vs-eta plot; tube flat, raw rising with slope ~-1/2.

SERVE / FALL-THROUGH BOUNDARY + F010 MUTATION IDIOM. Setup: fixture surrogate with known chart bounds, cusp windows (theta_cusp, Delta_theta), eta_floor, gamma-guard band, and inherited refusal exclusion balls. Operation: query points just inside vs just outside each boundary; then MUTATE a load-bearing bound (e.g. shrink a cusp Delta_theta, or move eta_priority) and re-run. Expected: in-bounds points are served, out-of-bounds/cusp-excluded/gamma-guard/refusal-ball points fall through to the exact engine (surrogate returns None -> likelihood uses the engine); the mutation makes at least one previously-correct serve/fall-through decision go RED (the falsification path is reachable). The engine-refusal contract is unchanged — the tube adds no new refusals. Diagnostic: a decision table (point -> served/fallthrough) with the mutated row flipped.

PARITY-AGNOSTIC TUBE ON BOTH CAUSTIC TOPOLOGIES (Professor Q8). Setup: build a tube segment on a positive-parity astroid fold arc AND on a saddle-parity deltoid fold arc using the same chart-building code, only the geometry input differing. Operation: reconstruct the envelope through each fold crossing and compare to the exact engine on held-out points. Expected: both achieve tube eps <1e-3 through the band; cusp windows (4 astroid cusps; 3 per deltoid lobe) are correctly excluded on both. Diagnostic: side-by-side eps-vs-eta ray plots for the two parities.

IMAGE-COUNT + GAMMA-GUARD SAFETY (parity-crossing analog of INS-8a-001; Professor Q7). Setup: fixture charts each labeled by image-count/parity. Operation: (a) query a point whose image-count region differs from a candidate chart's label; (b) query a point with |gamma-1|<delta_gamma. Expected: (a) the wrong-image-count chart is NOT used — selection either picks the correct-region chart or falls through; a point is never served by a chart trained at the wrong image-count/parity; (b) the gamma-guard-band point falls through to the exact engine. Diagnostic: a served-vs-fallthrough map across gamma showing the guard-band gap at gamma=1 and clean image-count region boundaries.

CUSP EXCLUSION FIDELITY (Professor Q6). Setup: a tube chart with recorded cusp windows on a fold arc with a known cusp. Operation: query points marching from mid-arc toward the cusp tip, crossing the Delta_theta window; also drop eta below eta_floor. Expected: points inside the cusp window (2/3-power region where the sqrt(eta) fold model is invalid) and below eta_floor fall through to the exact engine, never served by the tube spline; points just outside the window are served within tolerance. Diagnostic: served/fall-through vs (theta-theta_cusp) showing the exclusion wall.

SERIALIZATION ROUND-TRIP WITH PROVENANCE. Setup: an in-memory multi-chart fixture surrogate (tube + far-field, both parities). Operation: save() to a single npz, load() back, query both instances on a shared point set. Expected: values bit-identical; all charts, knots, coefficients, exclusion data, and the JSON provenance scalar (training grid, engine version/commit, training hash, prior-box def, chart count/types) survive the round-trip; NO separate manifest file is required. Diagnostic: max|value_reloaded - value_original| == 0 and a provenance-field-presence checklist.

BACKWARD COMPAT — 8a SINGLE-BOX ARTIFACT AS ONE-CHART SPECIAL CASE. Setup: a single-box (8a-style) artifact. Operation: load it under the new multi-chart LensAmplificationSurrogate and query the same points the 8a tests use; also confirm the 8a beta-elimination (eigenframe rotation to 1e-12) and the crown byte-identity (default None) still hold. Expected: identical results to the 8a single-box path; existing test_lensing_surrogate.py cases pass unchanged; default amplification_surrogate=None keeps every likelihood path byte-identical (crown max|diff|=0). Diagnostic: a diff of 8a-vs-multichart query outputs (all zero).

CENSUS-TOOL CORRECTNESS ON THE FIXTURE. Setup: the small trained fixture artifact + a handful of prior-box sample points with independently known outcomes. Operation: run the census core. Expected: served fraction and its fall-through breakdown match the hand-computed values; per-chart held-out envelope eps matches a direct interp-vs-engine computation; the gamma/image-count/eta-partitioned lnL tier check applies crown<=0.01 / strong-saddle<=0.1 / rescued<=RB with the surrogate error gated a factor >=10 below RB_ATOL=1.5 (F016), NOT compared to brute force; the JSON report includes the measured artifact size. Diagnostic: the census JSON tier table vs the hand-computed reference.

REGISTRATION VISIBILITY. Setup: the repo after WP2. Operation: parse .claude/spec/DATA_CONTRACTS.yaml and scripts/regenerate_consumer_graph.py; run the pipeline_graph list path. Expected: a lens_amplification_surrogate artifact entry exists with producer=the training script and consumers=the lensed likelihoods via LensAmplificationSurrogate.load; the LOADERS dict maps the artifact to LensAmplificationSurrogate.load; pipeline_graph list enumerates the new artifact and the consumer graph resolves the new loader. Diagnostic: the parsed artifact/loader entries printed alongside the pipeline_graph list output.
simplifier_inputs: TRIM chart class hierarchy -> two frozen dataclasses (TubeChart, FarFieldChart) in a list + a plain if/elif-style selection function; no polymorphism needed for two chart types.

TRIM the bespoke manifest -> a single npz already IS a manifest; store named per-chart tensors + one JSON-encoded provenance scalar. Per-chart files are a WP3 training-resumability concern, packed into the single artifact at the end.

TRIM to two load paths now (package-data default + explicit override); DEFER the data_registry cluster-path LOAD fallback behind a TODO until the artifact size is confirmed too large for git (the registry ENTRY itself is still added in WP2 as registration bookkeeping).
LEAN: keep training driver and census as SEPARATE scripts (they run independently / out of order), each a thin CLI over an importable, testable module (surrogate_training.py, surrogate_census.py).

LEAN: keep registration (WP2) a small SEPARATE Foreman-Lite WP — it is parallel yaml/loader bookkeeping independent of WP1's code; the brief confirms regenerate_consumer_graph.py already has the LOADERS pattern.
WATCH -> simplify resumability to a per-chart-file existence check (skip if present); NO structured within-chart progress manifest at smoke scale.
WATCH exclusion-region descriptor: store simple thresholds (eta_floor + a small list of (theta_cusp, Delta_theta) windows) per chart, not a general polygon/parametric boundary.
professor_inputs: Q1: u=sqrt(eta) is the correct minimal fold reparametrization — the ENVELOPE ITSELF (not just its derivative) carries a sqrt(eta) branch at a fold; fit Re and Im separately, both in u; the tube covers only the image-pair-present side (eta>0); theta is a bounded, NON-periodic per-fold-arc coordinate cusp-excluded at both ends.

Q2 (falsifiable test): tube vs equal-budget raw chart on the same near-caustic band; metric = 95th-percentile relative envelope error normalized by |E_engine|; PASS = tube eps_95 < raw eps_95 by factor >=3 AND tube eps_max < raw eps_max (coarse-fixture bar; production gain larger).

Q3 (fold-approach ray): geometric eta sequence halving toward the exclusion floor; tube error bounded <1e-3 and flat, raw error grows ~slope -1/2 on log-log; the diagnostic is the log-log eps-vs-eta plot.

Q4 (tiers): crown (gamma<~0.5) <=0.01 nats; strong-shear/saddle (gamma>~0.5) <=0.1 nats = ~1/15 of RB_ATOL, i.e. surrogate error kept a factor >=10 BELOW the RB-binning floor (F016), NOT vs brute force; rescued up to RB_ATOL=1.5. Partition by gamma (primary), image-count/parity (secondary), caustic-distance eta (tertiary); NEVER by gauge theta (F017).

Q5 (served fraction): 95% is sensible with margin; measure against the prior measure in SAMPLED coordinates by drawing from the prior directly (no importance weights); cusp exclusions + gamma=1 measure-zero refusal cost well under a couple percent.

Q6 (cusp exclusion): cusps carry a 2/3-power singularity the sqrt(eta) fold model does NOT absorb (would leave a C1-not-C2 kink -> spline ringing); exclude via (theta_cusp, Delta_theta) windows applied at all eta plus a global eta_floor; astroid has 4 cusps, each saddle deltoid lobe 3 (6 total).

Q7 (selection safety): guard stack = certified-box -> gamma guard band |gamma-1|<~1e-3 -> refusal exclusion balls -> read eta/theta/image_count from the partition -> image-count guard -> cusp/eta_floor exclusion -> tube>far-field by eta_priority -> else fall through; key selection ONLY on certified eta + image-count (never gauge theta); the gamma guard band prevents the parity/image-count mis-classification analog of INS-8a-001.

Q8 (parity): the tube machinery is PARITY-AGNOSTIC — a fold is a fold on the astroid and on the saddle deltoid; only the geometry input differs, so one chart-building routine serves both; the in-build fixture builds 'one tube + one far-field' per parity with the same code.

Q9 (cusp derivation): derive cusp locations from the geometry engine via caustic-speed minima (|dcaustic/dtheta|->0), ~100-200 theta samples/gamma, threshold ~1e-6, Delta_theta from the dip width; store per gamma; cross-check detected cusp count vs expected topology (4 for gamma<1, 6 for gamma>1) — no hard-coded counts.

Q10 (far-field completeness): far-field = plain raw-coord (gamma,y1_eig,y2_eig,log w) tensor spline, one per image-count region with an image-count guard, absorbing the one-image fold side and the deep interior incl. the w->0 macro plateau E->1/sqrt((1-kappa)^2-gamma^2); by Arnol'd/Thom, fold+cusp are the ONLY generic 2D singularities so nothing else needs special treatment once gamma=1 metamorphosis is guarded; skip a lobe-interior far-field chart when lobe diameter < 2*eta_max.
